channel.title: GTA6 PC news
channel.description: GTA 6 PC release date, leaks, ports and guides.

item.title: How to Play GTA 6 on PC Right Now (Legally): Remote Play Explained
item.description: There's no GTA 6 PC version yet, but Rockstar confirmed Remote Play. If you own a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S, you can stream GTA 6 to your PC today. Here's how.

item.title: GTA 6 Runs at 30 FPS on Consoles: Why the PC Version Matters
item.description: Digital Foundry found GTA 6 targets 30 FPS on every console, even PS5 Pro, with Series S at about 720p. Here's the breakdown and what PC players can expect.

item.title: Cyberleek Released the GTA 6 Executable (November 24 Update)
item.description: Cyberleek released the missing GTA 6 Xbox executable on November 23, 2026, and modders booted the game on PC within hours. Here is what happened and what it did and did not change.

item.title: Leonida: The GTA 6 Xbox-to-PC Recompilation Project Explained
item.description: Leonida was an open-source project that tried to recompile GTA 6's Xbox version to run natively on PC. It translated 26,503 shaders, but the game never booted, and the project shut down on November 24, 2026.

item.title: Has GTA 6 Been Dumped on PS5? Firmware 14.23 Explained
item.description: Sony made PS5 firmware 14.23 mandatory for GTA 6, while public jailbreaks stop at 13.60. Here's why GTA 6 hasn't been dumped and what it means for PC projects.

item.title: What Take-Two Said About GTA 6 (and PC) in Its Latest Earnings
item.description: Take-Two's November 2026 earnings call said GTA 6 pre-orders were far above expectations, but said nothing about a PC version. Here are the key takeaways.

item.title: GTA 6 Sales Forecasts: Record Pre-Orders and What PC Could Add
item.description: Analysts forecast $3.25–5.2 billion in GTA 6's first week. Here's what the pre-order records show, and why a PC release could add a second wave of sales.

item.title: Every Major GTA 6 Leak: From the 2022 Hack to the Cyberleek Xbox Build

item.description: A viral GTA 6 PC port video turned out to be GTA V footage. Another claims 25 fps on an RTX 5080 and is unverified. Here are the three fakes doing the rounds and a checklist that catches all of them.

item.title: GTA 6 Xbox Leak: Modders Race to Beat Rockstar to PC
item.description: A claimed 209 GB Xbox build leak has modders racing to run GTA 6 on PC before Rockstar's official version, a story now drawing reaction videos with millions of views. Here is what the race actually looks like.

item.title: Will GTA 6 Come to PC Game Pass? What Microsoft, Rockstar and Take-Two Have Said
item.description: GTA 6 is not on Xbox Game Pass or PC Game Pass, and no inclusion has been announced. Here is what the stores show, why Take-Two avoids day-one subscription releases, and when a Game Pass debut could realistically happen.

item.title: Will GTA 6 on PC Have Crossplay with PS5 and Xbox?

item.title: Can You Pre-Order GTA 6 on PC? What the Stores Actually Show
item.description: There is no GTA 6 PC pre-order anywhere. No Steam, Epic or Rockstar Launcher page exists, and no PC keys are real. Here is what the stores show and when a real pre-order could open.

item.description: GTA 6 already uses full ray tracing on consoles, and GTA V Enhanced brought ray tracing, DLSS and ultrawide support to PC. Here is what is confirmed, what is only expected, and what it means for your graphics card.

item.title: Can You Play GTA 6 on Steam Deck?
item.description: There is no native GTA 6 on Steam Deck because there is no PC version yet. Streaming from your own console works today, and GTA 5's history on Deck shows what to expect when the PC version arrives.

item.title: GTA 6 Update 1.002.002: First Patch Fixes Autosave, Crashes and More
item.description: Rockstar rolled out GTA 6 update 1.002.002 on November 23, 2026, the first patch since launch. It fixes autosave, crashes, stuck weather and more on PS5 and Xbox. Here are the full patch notes and what they mean for PC.

item.title: Will GTA 6 on PC Need the Rockstar Games Launcher?
item.description: Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA 6, so no launcher requirement is confirmed. But GTA V Enhanced, Rockstar's latest PC release, requires a Rockstar account and the Rockstar Games Launcher even on Steam. Here is what to expect.

item.title: GTA 6 Boots on PC Hours After Cyberleek Releases the Missing Executable
item.description: Cyberleek released the missing GTA 6 Xbox executable on November 23, 2026. Within about three hours, modders booted the game on a Windows PC, reaching the settings screens with no gameplay. Here is what happened and what it does not mean.

item.title: Rockstar Takes Action Against GTA 6 PC Port Projects as Leonida Shuts Down
item.description: Leonida, the open-source project trying to run GTA 6 on PC, has shut down after its developer stepped away, and several GTA 6 Discord servers have reportedly been taken down. Here is what is confirmed, what is only reported, and what happens next.
